title: Effect of Rosuvastatin Response in Healthy Subjects: Potential Mechanisms of Anti-inflammatory Effects

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to see whether Statin drugs will act as anti-inflammatories. The investigators will study this potential anti-inflammatory activity in healthy subjects.

Posted outcomes: Toll-like Receptor 4 Expression Pre- and Post-Treatment. timeframe=Before and after three weeks of treatment with rosuvastatin. Pre-treatment Tlr-4 Expression=12.37 (±9.8); Post-treatment Trl-4 Monocyte Expression=6.36 (±4.8)
